implementer.description: Makes code changes per the plan; in PR mode creates a branch, commits, pushes, and opens a PR via gh CLI

reviewer.description: Reviews code for correctness, style, and repro safety; reads the diff (gh pr diff or git diff) and approves/request-changes via gh pr review

verifier.description: Runs lint, type checks, and tests to validate changes; in PR mode waits for CI (gh pr checks) and merges (gh pr merge --squash)

analyst.description: Interprets results and produces comparison tables
